content: The Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake has officially been out for more than two weeks, and saying its reception has been good would be an understatement. It was named the No. 2 best-selling game on the Nintendo Switch 2, with over 5.2 million copies reportedly sold less than four days after launch. Longtime Zelda fans and newcomers alike have been enjoying revisiting the 1998 classic in this remake.
